subject: Whistic onboarding: field registry + temporary upload access
messages:
From: Sara Ng <sara.ng@bluehelix.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Whistic onboarding request: field registry + temporary upload access

Hi Soojin / Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. BlueHelix is ready to onboard our security profile into Whistic but we have two asks up front: a) a canonical field mapping exercise so our CAIQ/SIG answers align with Redwood's Whistic profile fields, and b) a short-lived upload path (presigned URLs or scoped STS) so we can push a single evidence package without creating long-lived IAM users.

I attached a CSV with our current field names and a PDF snapshot of our SIG answers (bluehelix_SIG_snapshot.pdf). Can your team help map the CSV columns to the Whistic field IDs and advise the preferred ingest method (presign vs SFTP)?

Target timeline: we'd like this staged in Whistic for an internal audit week starting Oct 26. If we can get a quick runbook and one presign upload window before Oct 20, that would be ideal.

Notes: retention for the uploaded bundle should be 90 days; we can sign an upload manifest.

Thanks,
Sara Ng
Security Program Manager
BlueHelix Industries
attachments: bluehelix_whistic_mapping.csv, bluehelix_SIG_snapshot.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Ng <sara.ng@bluehelix.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding request: field registry + temporary upload access

Sara — thanks, received. We can absolutely help. Proposed plan: 

1) Field registry mapping (owner: Laura) — we will reconcile your CSV to Whistic field IDs and return a mapping CSV + notes.
2) Temporary upload (owner: Rishi) — we can offer a presigned-URL window for a single S3 prefix or provide a scoped STS role for uploads.
3) Verification & ingest (owner: Soojin) — once uploaded we will validate manifests and complete the Whistic profile update.

Laura and Rishi — can you validate the timeline feasibility (goal: presign window and mapping by Oct 19)? I linked a short internal runbook below for the presign flow.

Runbook (internal): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cExampleDriveLink

Sara — one question for the mapping: do you have any custom CAIQ fields we should preserve verbatim, or is normalization acceptable (we'll keep originals as metadata)? Also confirm if the 90-day retention on the uploaded bundle is mandatory for you or flexible.

I'll circle back after Laura's mapping pass.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sara Ng <sara.ng@bluehelix.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding request: field registry + temporary upload access

Quick tech check and suggested checklist:

- Preferred ingest: presigned PUT to a scoped S3 prefix (simpler for one-off bundles). We can create a prefix and generate pre-signed URLs valid for 48 hours.
- Required from BlueHelix: target S3 prefix (or we can create one), expected bundle size, and whether the upload will be a single .zip or multiple files.
- Retention: we will honor a 90-day retention on the staging prefix; after verification we will either delete or move to a locked evidence bucket per Redwood policy. Confirm if BlueHelix needs proof-of-deletion.
- Manifest expectations: simple manifest.csv listing filename, SHA256, and file type. We can provide a validation script (Python) that verifies checksums and uploads an ack to the Jira ticket.

Action items for Sara: confirm (A) bundle format (single zip vs files), (B) max bundle size, (C) preferred upload dates/time window (we can stand up the presign window Oct 18–19).

I'll prepare a small presign generator and a manifest-validator script and drop them to the Drive link once ready.

-Rishi
Senior Platform Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Ng <sara.ng@bluehelix.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding request: field registry + temporary upload access

Thanks — this all looks good. Quick answers: 

- Bundle format: single zip (bluehelix_whistic_bundle.zip), ~1.2GB max.
- Preferred upload window: Oct 18 between 10:00–14:00 PT. If presign is available we will use it; otherwise scoped STS is acceptable.
- Retention: 90 days is required for audit purposes; we would like a proof-of-deletion notification when files are purged.
- Custom fields: we have two internal CAIQ-derived fields (BH-DataResidency and BH-VendorTier) — please preserve them in the mapping as-is.

Attached: bluehelix_whistic_mapping.csv (column mapping) and bluehelix_SIG_snapshot.pdf.

If you can pre-populate the Whistic profile with the mapped answers and confirm the presign flow by Oct 16, we'll lock in the Oct 18 upload. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
